name: qnsqy
stderr:
QNSQY: Post-quantum data encryption (NIST FIPS 203/204/205; HQC and FN-DSA are pre-standard)

Usage: qnsqy [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  encrypt            Encrypt a file (password or recipient-based, quantum-resistant)
  decrypt            Decrypt a .qs file
  symmetric          Simple symmetric encryption using only a password
  shred              Securely delete a file (3-pass overwrite)
  version            Show version information (use --verbose for full details)
  hash               Compute and display cryptographic hash of a file (BLAKE3 or SHA3-256)
  hash-verify        Verify a file against a known hash value
  encode             Encode data (Base64, Hex, Base32, Base58, URL)
  decode             Decode data (Base64, Hex, Base32, Base58, URL)
  verify-integrity   Verify file integrity without decryption (no password needed)
  verify-release     Verify a release artifact's ML-DSA-87 signature (supply-chain integrity)
  sign-release       Sign a release artifact with a detached ML-DSA-87 signature (release manager)
  keygen-sign        Generate a signing keypair (ML-DSA, SLH-DSA, FN-DSA, LMS)
  keygen-enc         Generate an encryption keypair (ML-KEM, HQC) for recipient-based encryption
  sign               Sign a file with a private key
  verify             Verify a file signature against a public key
  key-import         Import a public key (Pro/Business)
  key-export         Export a key to file (Pro/Business)
  batch              Batch encrypt/decrypt multiple files (Pro)
  audit              View audit log (Pro)
  rekey              Change password on encrypted file (Pro)
  vault              Password vault: store and retrieve secrets securely (Pro)
  split              Split a secret into M-of-N shares (Business)
  combine            Combine shares to recover a secret (Business)
  threshold-encrypt  Threshold encrypt a file to N recipients, requiring M keys to decrypt (Business)
  threshold-decrypt  Threshold decrypt a file using M private keys (Business)
  timelock           Time-lock encryption using RSW puzzles (Business)
  stego              Hide encrypted data in carrier files (Business)
  polyglot           Create polyglot files (Pro+) — single-carrier (PDF/ZIP/PNG/JPEG), triple (R74 JPEG+ZIP+PDF), self-extracting (R74 .sh/.bat), or with embedded tripwire URL (R74 PNG only)
  abe                R74 Feature 5: Attribute-Based Encryption (CP-ABE, Pro+ — Pro and Business)
  keyfile            Keyfile-only encryption (Pro+ — Pro and Business)
  provenance         Account provenance signing: prove which account produced a file and detect any later tampering (ransomware tripwire). Appends a QPRV trailer signed with your on-device ML-DSA identity key
  deniable           Deniable encryption (Business)
  scan               Scan directory for classical cryptography files (free on all tiers)
  migrate            Migrate classical crypto files to post-quantum encryption (Business)
  policy             Manage organization encryption policies (Business)
  group              Manage recipient groups for threshold encryption (Business)
  escrow-keygen      Generate escrow key pair for organization key recovery (Business)
  escrow-decrypt     Decrypt a file using organization escrow key (Business)
  push               Push encrypted data to a zero-knowledge remote (R2/S3)
  pull               Restore data from a zero-knowledge remote
  sync               Sync a directory to a zero-knowledge remote with change detection
  remote             Manage remote storage profiles and test connectivity (~/.config/qnsqy/remotes.toml)
  signup             Create a new QNSQY account (Free tier)
  login              Log in with API key
  logout             Log out (remove stored API key)
  status             Show account status (tier, credits, plan)
  generate-secret    Generate a cryptographic secret (32 bytes hex)
  quickstart         Interactive setup guide for new users
  reset-state        Reset corrupted state files (rate limit, audit logs)
  devices            Manage registered devices on your subscription
  usage
